summary: KYC overhaul E2E regression — backend + frontend. 45/45 pytest cases pass (11 new in test_kyc_overhaul.py + 34 carried-over legacy after KYC-aware updates). All 11 backend KYC scenarios from the review request verified end-to-end against the public ingress: missing-docs 400, pending-create 201 + auto-kyc record, distributor 400 for missing docs, pending agent login -> 403 with exact message, approve writes to both db.kyc + db.users + audit 'kyc_approved' + agent can login, reject writes both + persists reason + audit 'kyc_rejected' + login 403 'rejected', /admin/kyc shape (user_id/aadhaar_path/pan_path/status/user{full_name,phone,address}/distributor_name/submitted_at; agents only), pending_kyc_count in /admin/stats/financial cross-checks with len(pending /admin/kyc rows), pre-existing agents (kyc_status=approved & empty aadhaar_path) still approved, /api/kyc and /api/kyc/mine return 404/405, distributor-created agent shows distributor_name (not 'Admin'). Frontend (Playwright): admin login OK, kpi-pending-kyc visible & navigates to /admin/kyc, KYC Review sidebar item present, /admin/agents shows Aadhaar/PAN FileUpload dropboxes — submitting without uploads shows 'Aadhaar and PAN documents are required' toast, /admin/kyc table columns exactly [Agent Name, Distributor, Phone, Address, Aadhaar, PAN, Status, Submitted, Action], inline amber login-kyc-error renders for pending agent with exact backend message. /app/frontend/src/pages/agent/Kyc.jsx is deleted; AgentKyc no longer in App.js; dashboardNav.js has no agent KYC entry.
critical_code_review_comments: create_subuser correctly gates body.aadhaar_path/pan_path for role='agent' and auto-upserts a /admin/kyc record on creation. Clean.
Login KYC gate at server.py:218-223 reads kyc_status with default 'approved', so pre-existing agents (no field) and migrated ones both login. Verified against live admin/users listing.
_migrate_kyc_status() runs in @app.on_event('startup') — works but FastAPI startup events are deprecated; consider migrating to lifespan handlers (already noted in iteration_2).
/admin/kyc enrichment trusts user.kyc_status as the source of truth and overwrites it.status — good, prevents drift between db.users and db.kyc.
server.py is now 1374 lines — KYC adds ~80 lines; the split-into-routers recommendation from iteration_2 remains valid.
Audit endpoint is /admin/audit-logs (not /admin/audit) — legacy tests needed adjustment; consider documenting the contract.

Three suites exist now: test_kyc_overhaul.py (KYC-specific), test_makfinpay_no_agent_code.py (full flow), test_refactor_regression.py (refactor regression). All idempotent. The KYC contract is: agents require aadhaar_path+pan_path at create; backend stores any string (uploaded file path) — tests use '/uploads/test_aadhaar.pdf' style strings without actually uploading. rca of the issue: No production bugs found. Two legacy test suites were failing because they pre-dated the KYC overhaul and were creating agents without aadhaar_path/pan_path (which now correctly returns 400) and then trying to log in (which now correctly returns 403 for pending KYC). Both were updated to satisfy the new contract; they exercise unchanged business flows after the KYC step.
